messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick heads up — Apollo dedicated pool warmup slated for TOMORROW 10:00 PT. We need quota bump, autoscale shadow test, and a short load sweep. Who can own run coordination?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I can own orchestration + traffic script. Need the exact quota numbers and warmup windows from infra.
Eli (Infra Eng): We can bump to 220 reserved units for the window 10:00–12:00 PT. Autoscale shadow will simulate 75%–120% of expected peak.
Maya (CSM): 220 sounds good. Customer has a soft SLA for 95th p99 latency < 350ms. We'll validate against that.
Jordan (Oncall): I'll be on pager during the window. Can we add a short canary at 10:05 to verify model fallback/variant swap?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Yes — plan: 10:00 smoke -> 10:05 canary (20 rps) -> 10:15 full sweep (gradual ramp to 400 rps over 25m) -> 11:30 soak -> 11:55 drain.
Eli (Infra Eng): Ops note: enable prefix KV caching and set batching target to 8 tokens to reflect production mix. Toggle `cache=true` in the staging route.
Maya (CSM): I'll notify the customer of the cadence. Also capture enablement feedback: short questionnaire after the run.
Jordan (Oncall): If p99 > 500ms or error rate > 1% for 3 consecutive 1m windows, we abort and fallback to smaller model variant.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Script snippet for load generator (wrk):
```
wrk -t8 -c200 -d00:25:00 http://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -s apollo_script.lua
```
Ravi (Solutions Eng): apollo_script.lua will rotate prompts and simulate KV reuse. I'll push it to the runbook under `/runs/apollo/warmup/`.
Eli (Infra Eng): KMS keys rotate maintenance is scheduled at 09:50 PT — we will postpone rotation to 13:00 for this customer window. Confirmed with security.
Maya (CSM): Excellent. Can someone post a short rollback checklist? I want it in the thread for the customer-facing runbook.
Jordan (Oncall): Rollback checklist: 1) Stop load generator 2) Scale pool to baseline (60 units) via control-plane 3) Remove cache flag 4) Re-route traffic to last stable model 5) Open incident bridge if errors persist.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Adding quick validation commands for post-run checks:
```
curl -sS https://staging.redwood/api/status | jq '.pools.apollo | {units,healthy,avg_p99}'
```
Maya (CSM): I'll schedule a 30m postmortem at 12:15 PT to capture feedback and note renewal risk signals (if customer sees high latency we'll list remediation actions).
Eli (Infra Eng): Note: toggling `cache` may change token economics; we'll log token counts and cost delta in telemetry.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Can customer run a small shadow job beforehand? A 5m dry-run with their most common prompt set at 09:30 PT would help.
Maya (CSM): They agreed — I'll get them to run the 09:30 dry-run and to share logs.
Jordan (Oncall): I'll create a short incident runbook in case of model OOMs: `oom -> auto-fallback -> drain -> alert` and pin it in run channel.
OpsBot: Scheduled maintenance postponed: KMS rotation -> 13:00 PT (by request).
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Final checklist I'll send to the customer doc: quota=220, dry-run=09:30, warmup=10:00–12:00, canary=10:05, rollback steps (Jordan), postmortem=12:15. Please ACK. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Solutions Eng): ACK. I'll upload scripts and add runbook link.
Eli (Infra Eng): ACK. I'll prepare telemetry dashboards and ensure autoscale shadow policy is in place.
Jordan (Oncall): ACK. I'll be oncall and ready to open bridge if needed.
Maya (CSM): Great — I'll close the loop with the customer now and share this thread in their onboarding doc. :white_check_mark:
